The '''2019–20 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team''' represented [[Wichita State University]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They played their home games at [[Charles Koch Arena]] in [[Wichita, Kansas]] and were led by head coach [[Gregg Marshall]], who coached in his 13th and final season at the school. They are members of the [[American Athletic Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2018-19 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Shockers]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 22–15, 10–8 in [[2018–19 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] and finished in sixth place. In the first round of the [[2019 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] the Shockers would go on to win against the 11 seeded [[2018–19 East Carolina Pirates men's basketball team|East Carolina]], would beat [[2018–19 Temple Owls men's basketball team|Temple]] in the quarterfinals, but would lose in the semifinals to the eventual champions of the AAC, [[2018–19 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]].

Wichita State would receive a six seed in the [[2019 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] and would beat [[2018–19 Furman Paladins men's basketball team|Furman]] in the first round, beat [[2018–19 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]] in the second round, and beat [[2018–19 Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball team|Indiana]], but would lose to [[2018–19 Lipscomb Bisons men's basketball team|Lipscomb]] in the semifinals.
